name: PROENERGY
description: Independent aeroderivative OEM and packager based in Sedalia, Missouri, running the largest independent aero depot network. Its PE6000 is a 50 MW fast-start LM6000-interchangeable package; 13 PE6000 units (650 MW) were booked in 2026 for Crusoe AI data centres.
